# Library loans

## Requirements

- Overdue notices must be sent within two days of the due date, under the Lending Policy 4.

## Stories

- As a borrower, I want an overdue notice within two days of the due date so that I can return the book before a fine builds up.
- As a librarian, I want to scan a book back in so that the shelf stays accurate.
- As a borrower, I want to renew a loan online so that I avoid a trip.
